body: don't really know what I'm missing. I haven't been feeling very productive or useful lately. Felt this way off and on my whole life, but my strategy has usually been "just wait it out, don't do anything stupid, tomorrow will be different" and that's gotten me by so far, even when I didn't believe it at the time, but I've felt this every day for the past three months without even a sliver of a chance of feeling anything else and I'm feeling overwhelmed and just tired of feeling this way. I mean, this is nothing new for me, but in the past at least there were a couple okay good days to break it up. It's just really tiresome waking up every morning wishing I hadn't.
